note: PM_CD86p: activated patrolling (non-classical) monocytes — sparse cluster at high CD86; like the intermediate-monocyte branch, the parent population is small so the gate captures essentially the entire CD86+ tail.
tips: Activation readout for patrolling (non-classical) monocytes. PM_CD86p: CD86+. Patrolling monocytes are normally less APC-competent than classical monocytes. In-panel co-marker prior: HLA-DR (Comp-BV510-A) tends to co-move with CD86 on activation — complementary readout.
